title: One settlement on the paid work queue
description: Append-only. A commit that removes or edits an existing receipt fails CI.

paid_to.description: Checksum-validated by validate.py before merge; the pattern alone is not sufficient.

block_hash.description: The only field in this repository permitted to hold 64 hex characters.

seller.description: The handle the job was claimed under. Written by settle.py.

confirmed.description: Always true: settle.py refuses to write a receipt for a block a node has not reported confirmed, so an unconfirmed receipt cannot exist.

node_queried.description: The public node that was asked whether the block is confirmed. Named so a reader can ask a different one.

claim_url.description: Carried over from the job. Absent when the job carried none.
